releases.body:
This release includes five merged fixes:

- DSH supports Windows command launchers, UTF-8 summary input and reliable child-process handoffs (#819).
- Codex capture uses unique temporary files on macOS (#820).
- DSH memory Web routes honor the host authentication and request-origin checks (#822).
- `memsearch expand --no-section` returns only the chunk's source range (#816).
- DSH provides a recall hint and lets the agent search when needed; recall skills use the calling workspace's collection (#823).

Plugin versions: Claude Code 0.4.22, DSH 0.1.8, OpenClaw 0.3.22, OpenCode 0.4.2. Codex uses the current installer. Shared Windows maintenance fixes are included across the plugins. Existing memory files, anchors and configuration remain usable without data migration.

MemSearch 0.4.22 includes memory reliability fixes across the CLI and agent integrations.

- Memory expansion begins at the retrieved chunk’s own section, Unix socket Milvus addresses use server connection handling, and compacted memory headings include a timestamp.
- Claude Code hooks select a working Python 3 interpreter, locate the bundled summary prompt reliably, reject native summarizer error responses, and deliver recall hints to the model.
- New DSH configurations use local ONNX embeddings. Existing embedding configurations remain unchanged.
- OpenClaw memory tools and session provenance support the current SDK. OpenCode capture reuses project roots during transcript scans.
- Claude Code and Codex hooks avoid global Milvus Lite process cleanup. Shared memory guidance and maintenance scripts are refreshed.

Released components: Python core 0.4.22; Claude Code 0.4.21; DSH 0.1.7; OpenClaw 0.3.21; OpenCode 0.4.1. Codex is installed from the current release commit.

## What's Changed

- chore: release core 0.4.22 and memory plugins (#813)
- fix: select working Python 3 for Claude Code hooks (#809)
- fix(claude-code): locate summary prompt from the Stop script (#812)
- docs: clarify embedding setup across integrations (#810)
- fix(dsh): default unconfigured memory to ONNX (#811)
- fix(compact): time-stamp the Memory Compact heading (#768) (#796)
- fix: reject native Claude summarizer error responses (#805)
- fix(opencode): cache project roots during capture scans (#808)
- fix(claude-code): deliver the UserPromptSubmit recall hint to the model (#739)
- fix: treat unix socket Milvus URIs as a server (#784)
- fix: `expand` starts the section at the chunk's own heading (#775)
- docs: simplify OpenCode setup and refresh plugin guidance (#801)
- feat(opencode): support V2 and release plugin 0.4.0 (#800)
- fix(openclaw): restore memory tools and session provenance (#799)
- fix(hooks): remove global Milvus Lite process cleanup (#797)
- chore(dsh): release 0.1.6 (#789)
- fix(dsh): use a producer-owned source kind for injected memory messages (#762)

## What's Changed

- release: prepare v0.4.21 (#765)
- Use the stable Jev alias and relocate evaluation docs (#761)
- Add optional Jev reranking and bilingual evaluation (#758)
- fix: prevent read paths from creating missing collections (#760)
- fix: search growing rows on Milvus Server (#757)
- fix(codex): filter composite host instruction envelopes (#754)
- fix(codex): parse response-item rollout messages safely (#751)
- fix(openclaw): update prompt hook compatibility (#744)

## What's Changed

- release: prepare v0.4.20 (#741)
- fix(dsh): snapshotEvents compat and stdin EOF for headless summarizer (#737)
- docs(plugin): explain model selection for forked skills (#733)
- fix(config): respect configured collection priority (#726)
- fix(hooks): avoid reindexing Milvus Lite on every plugin stop (#723)
- fix: clarify memory recall status messages (#722)
- fix(opencode): omit turn text when summaries fail (#719)
- perf(hooks): refresh the PyPI check off the session-start blocking path (#676) (#695)
- fix: enable best-effort Milvus Lite on Windows (#713)
- docs: route releases through repository skill (#712)
- fix: preserve latest session memory within context budget (#691)
- chore(release): bump plugin versions for single-source skills (#711)
- refactor(skills): single-source memory-config and memory-to-skill across platforms (#710)
- fix(opencode): run derive-collection.sh via argv, not a shell string (#681) (#682)
- ci: automate DSH plugin releases (#702)
- chore(dsh): release 0.1.3 (#701)

## What's Changed

- Bump versions for 0.4.19 release (#700)
- docs: use Codex product name consistently (#699)
- docs: add DeepSeek Harness plugin documentation (#698)
- fix(dsh): harden memsearch browser preview (#697)
- feat(dsh): add collapsible review dock and read-only .memsearch browser (#696)
- feat(dsh): add skill-candidate review panel UI to the web composer dock (#694)
- chore(dsh): release @zilliz/memsearch-dsh 0.1.1 (#690)
- feat(dsh): background maintenance (PROJECT.md/USER.md, skill distillation) (#689)
- fix(dsh): patch name must match npm package name (#688)
- chore(dsh): publish as @zilliz/memsearch-dsh (#687)
